ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 65% high-intensity (white) to 35% low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous black pigmentation cluster centered at the notch extending into the mid-ventral lobes. High-contrast black mottling and discrete circular spots localized on the distal half of the right lobe. Distinct black linear streaks on the mid-left and mid-right lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Approximate 120-degree V-shaped notch with a bounding-box depth extending approximately 1/6th of the vertical lobe span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serrations along the trailing edge with pixel-amplitudes varying between 2 and 10 pixels; highest frequency of serration peaks observed on the distal sections of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Gentle convex curvature fitted to the trailing edges, transitioning to a slight upward taper at the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular dark pixel clusters (spots) on the right lobe; brownish-white textured clusters at the extreme tips of both lobes indicative of external colonization.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of multiple parallel linear dark marks (rake marks) on the medial-left and inner-right lobes, plus individual unaligned scratches crossing the white fields.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant rake marks consisting of 3-4 parallel lines on both lobes; substantial barnacle clusters present on the outer margins of both fluke tips.
other_distinctive_markers: A series of roughly concentric or 'target' shaped dark pigment spots on the distal portion of the right lobe.
